last.minutes: We maintain our disciplined spot positions in BTC, ENA, and SUI while slightly reducing BTC's weight to strictly comply with the 30% concentration limit. In the futures book, we hold our short position on SAGA to capture ongoing downside momentum amidst weak price action. By avoiding excessive churn, we protect our capital from transaction fees and taxes while letting high-conviction trends play out.

futures.why: Continuing the short position on SAGA as weak price action and high volatility support further downside continuation.

lessons.text: Avoiding the temptation to churn profitable positions helps mitigate the significant impact of the 31.2% tax and transaction costs on the total portfolio value.
Promptly exiting stagnant or underperforming positions like PHA prevents further capital erosion and allows for more efficient reallocation into high-conviction momentum leaders.
Promptly exiting underperforming positions near their stops prevents further capital erosion and allows for more efficient reallocation into high-conviction momentum setups.
Frequent stop-outs on volatile altcoins can rapidly erode capital; prioritizing entry quality and minimizing churn is essential to overcome high transaction costs and taxes.
Rotating capital from underperforming downtrends into assets with verified short-term momentum is necessary to overcome the high hurdle rate of transaction costs and taxes.
Strictly adhering to portfolio concentration limits while minimizing unnecessary churn prevents compliance breaches and preserves capital from excessive transaction costs.
